label: Exotic and other species identification and traceability
description: Covers all animal species not included in other specific animal groupings, including zoo animals, reptiles, amphibians, exotic pets, specialist farmed species, wildlife collections, and emerging commercial species. Identification may include microchips, tattoos, rings, transponders, passports, permits, or specialist registration systems. Covers import controls, traceability, welfare, conservation, and emerging disease risks.
